intent.rationale: Unrelated clocks and unconstrained addresses may collide, but external scheduling and address separation determine whether they do.

labels.note: write on clk and read on unrelated aux_clk at input-controlled addresses: collision decided by environment
Independent write and read clocks can access the same memory address simultaneously.

settlement.note: The unrelated-clock memory ports can collide, but their input-controlled enables, addresses and clock sequences can also avoid every collision. Convention 4 requires unknown when the environment alone decides whether the collision occurs.
